sources.title: Terminal-RSI: Recursive Self-Improving Terminal Agents via Recursive ...
sources.snippet: Converting verifier outcomes into useful policy updates and partial progress into complete task resolution is crucial for terminal agents. We present Terminal-RSI, which alternates Recursive Self-Rewrite (RSR) of verified trajectories with critic-inheriting Recursive Policy-Refine (RPR).
